Upgrade pura to the latest GitHub release (public; no sign-in needed).
Downloads the release for your OS/arch, verifies its sha256 against
checksums.txt, and atomically replaces the running binary.

  pura upgrade                  # upgrade to latest (no-op if already current)
  pura upgrade --check          # only report whether a newer version exists
  pura upgrade --force          # reinstall even if already latest
  pura upgrade --version v0.2.0 # install a specific version (incl. downgrade)

Usage:
  pura upgrade [flags]

Aliases:
  upgrade, update

Flags:
      --check            Only check for a newer version; don't install
      --force            Reinstall even if already on the latest version
  -h, --help             help for upgrade
      --version string   Target version (vX.Y.Z); defaults to latest

Global Flags:
      --api-url string   Override API endpoint
      --handle string    User handle (accepts alice or @alice; defaults to _)
      --jq string        Filter JSON output with jq expression
      --json             Force JSON output
      --profile string   Use named profile
      --quiet            Raw data only (no envelope)
      --token string     Override stored token
  -v, --verbose          Verbose output
